messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The opioid activity of tramadol is due to tramadol's binding to mu-opioid receptors.

The relation 'is classified as' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is categorized or classified under the therapeutic or pharmacological category specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
B. 'includes': The subject drug class or category includes the specific drug or entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
